en: Then I shall take my leave.
You're a strange man.
Faced with beauty like mine, you'd just
turn and leave...
I've just ordered this house remodeled.
Even if it's small, I want to live in
a more lavish home, you see.
Soon it will be reborn as a splendid home
truly worthy of me.
Do come again to gaze upon
my beauty.
Oh my, so you couldn't resist my charms
after all, and came to my house.
Hmhm, aren't you sweet.
Wait here, I'll have my servant prepare
some tea...
I merely stopped by.
I do not intend to stay long.
Oh, don't be so cold...
You're a gentleman of leisure, with time
and money to spare, aren't you?
...Well, I suppose you could say that.
You see, I only keep company with
the upper classes.
O-oh my,
I was just taking a nap.
Letting a gentleman see my sleepy face!
How embarrassing...
Lately I've come to look forward to
seeing your face.
You may not believe it, but
there was a time when I was
terribly poor...
Poverty is nothing but misery. I hated it.
I wanted a life of elegance,
no matter what it took.
So I kept company with all sorts of people,
and now I have connections in society.
A life of elegance is my revenge.
On life itself, that is.
Hey, woman...
My, what is it?
Calling at this hour without any
appointment...
What on earth do you mean by it?
So my charms proved too much for you
after all, is that it?
Do you remember something you
once told me?
"You have time and money to spare,"
you said.
What is this? All of a sudden...
Yes, I do remember saying that.
But what does that have to do with...?
Your hunch was right.
My time is eternal, and my wealth
will never run out...
Because I am a vampire...
Wh-what are you doing?! ...Ah, aaah!!
Because human blood and human riches
are all as good as mine...
But I'll make an exception and invite you in.
So young, and such refinement...
You must have been raised in a fine family.
Oh, well...
Oh, no, I just stopped by...
I'll be going home.
Oh, don't say such sad things.
Stay a little longer and relax.
...Er, all right.
You see, I only keep company with
refined people like you.
Please, command me as you will
Phew... I'm not feeling well.
I'm feverish, and my head is foggy
Please give me your orders.
note: Shared with Mike (msg 303725) after 'I am your loyal servant.'

en: I'll carry out whatever you ask
Oh dear... a scratch on my face.
And I certainly haven't had a fall.
Oh, a new face. Are you from abroad?
